item.title: Dawson’s Creek star James Van Der Beek dies at 48
item.description: 'Our beloved James David Van Der Beek passed peacefully this morning. He met his final days with courage, faith, and grace,' his wife Kimberly writes on Instagram

item.title: [OPINION] The Chinese embassy just told you how it controls local media
item.description: Beijing explains how pro-China propaganda is the 'core mission' of Chinese-language media in the Philippines, while contending that transparency is the real threat to free speech

item.title: Detdet Pepito, Tigresses look to pounce on ‘best chance’ at elusive UAAP title
item.description: UST star libero Detdet Pepito hopes to get a triumphant swan song as she seeks to lead the Tigresses to their first UAAP women's volleyball championship in 16 years

item.title: Instagram chief defends youth mental health decisions at trial
item.description: Instagram's head Adam Mosseri defends the platform in a trial over youth mental health claims, as parents voice concerns about social media's impact on children

item.title: EU says TikTok in breach of law due to ‘addictive’ features, infinite scroll
item.description: A preliminary investigation finds TikTok in violation of the Digital Services Act for addictive design, urging changes to mitigate harm to users, including both minors and vulnerable adults

item.title: The alleged evidence implicating Marcos in flood control kickbacks
item.description: Can purported text messages yet to be released to the public be the smoking gun that directly ties Marcos to the flood control corruption scandal?

item.title: Rappler among 12 global publishers awarded AI innovation grant
item.description: The JournalismAI Innovation Challenge, supported by the Google News Initiative, selected Rappler from 373 applicants worldwide, to develop AI tools that deepen audience engagement and trust

item.title: FACT CHECK: Marcos does not have cancer, says Palace
item.description: Malacañang debunks claims that Marcos has colon cancer. The President was diagnosed with diverticulitis, not cancer.

item.description: Zhipu AI's open-source GLM-5 model features enhanced coding capabilities and the ability to perform long-running agent tasks
